title: cad.like.audio/big-picture@2
description: The Big Picture route between CAD.Like.audio (customer) and WEB.OsApi server.py (supplier), the sheet filed as IFC (ISO 16739-1:2024, IFC4X3_ADD2, ISO 10303-21 STEP text): GET /api/v2/big-picture answers 'read'; POST /api/v2/big-picture takes 'write' and answers 'saved' (200) or 'refused' (400 invalid / 409 digest conflict / 413 over 4 MB / 500 read-back). The STEP is the CAD's schematic IFC (src/io/bigPicture/bigPictureIfc.ts, IFC-CORE-DELTAS cad-6): placements are occurrences carrying APK_Placement, connectors IfcRelConnectsPorts with an APK_SchematicWire annotation, rack/kit groups IfcElementAssembly (IfcRelAggregates), other groups IfcGroup (IfcRelAssignsToGroup), each carrying APK_SchematicGroup; the server refuses a file whose group tree gives an occurrence two owners or a group two parents or a cycle. big-picture@1 (JSON, /api/v1/big-picture) is read-only from 2026-11-06 and removed on 2027-01-01. Validate with ../validate.mjs; samples.json has one of each, written from its $sheet.

step.description: An ISO 10303-21 file, FILE_SCHEMA(('IFC4X3_ADD2')), at most 4 MB.
